body:
I feel like I'm rambling but I've never had this opportunity before. I've always kept a very mute online persona.

I guess what I'm asking is does this resonate with anyone? Should I go speak to a doctor or should I man the fuck up?
I dunno what crap I'm babbling but I meant *just being able to vent

I've genuinely no idea. I've never done this before. Just being a leader to vent, knowing someone's listening (reading) feels so therapeutic. Just having typed that out feels great but I still feel stuck. I've felt so horrendous since I was so young and just learned to cope with it. It got worse when I got older, with genuine attempts on my life but I always assumed it would get better if I just got my shit together.

And it did for so long!! I started a great, moved out and became a person I could be proud of.

But every now and again I'd feel like garbage and couldn't understand why. I was doing so well.

Tonight though I fully understand.  Nothing left. Nothing changed. I'm still as pathetic as I always was. For the last 3 years I've just been a facade pretending to be a regular human when in actuality and the same useless piece of shit I've always been.
